title: Theoretical analysis towards accurate optomechanical detection of quantum gravity effects
summary: Optomechanical systems offer a promising platform for observing dynamical signatures of quantum gravity through precision measurements of quantum harmonic oscillator dynamics. However, most existing analyses consider only the linear radiation-pressure interaction while neglecting higher-order optomechanical couplings and laser phase noise. These neglected contributions can be comparable in magnitude to the predicted quantum-gravity corrections and may therefore introduce spurious signals or mask the genuine physical effect.
